2608.06481.title: LyEvO: Lyapunov-Guided Evolutionary Optimization for Safe and Robust Sim-to-Real Policy Learning
2608.06481.paper_summary: Training controllers that are safe and robust in simulation, and systematically assessing their readiness for real-world deployment, remain key challenges in sim-to-real transfer. To address this, we propose LyEvO, a physics-grounded framework that combines constrained Evolutionary Optimization and Statistical Model Checking (SMC)-based verification with Lyapunov-based stability analysis. Leveraging prior knowledge of the system dynamics, LyEvO uses Lyapunov analysis to compute an initial candidate stability region. An iterative loop then uses operational scenarios drawn from this region to jointly optimize and statistically verify a policy, and subsequently expands the region's boundaries based on the verification outcome. This integrated procedure provides a practical criterion for assessing deployment readiness. We evaluate LyEvO on Cartpole and 3D Quadrotor benchmarks through extensive simulations and targeted real-world experiments, demonstrating safe and robust sim-to-real transfer.
2608.06481.paper_summary_zh: 訓練在模擬中安全且穩健的控制器，以及系統性地評估其在現實世界部署的準備情況，仍然是從模擬到現實轉移中的關鍵挑戰。為了解決這個問題，我們提出了LyEvO，一個基於物理的框架，結合了受限的進化優化和基於統計模型檢查（SMC）的驗證，並進行李雅普諾夫穩定性分析。利用系統動力學的先驗知識，LyEvO使用李雅普諾夫分析來計算初始候選穩定區域。然後，通過從該區域提取的操作場景進行迭代循環，以共同優化和統計驗證一個策略，並根據驗證結果擴展該區域的邊界。這一綜合程序提供了一個實用的標準來評估部署的準備情況。我們在Cartpole和3D四旋翼基準上通過廣泛的模擬和針對性的現實世界實驗來評估LyEvO，展示了安全且穩健的從模擬到現實轉移。
